passive.name: Waveriding
passive.text:
Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **18/21/24/27/30%**. When the wearer uses Elation Skill, gains "Updraft," which increases the wearer's SPD by **24/28/32/36/40%**. If the Elation Skill used is different from the one used last time, additionally gains "Uptrend," which increases the wearer's Elation by **40/55/70/85/100%**.
When every wave starts or after the wearer uses Elation Skill **3** time(s), recovers 1 Skill Point.

passive.name: Decision
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When the wearer uses an Elation Skill, increases Elation by **12/14/16/18/20%**, stacking up to **2** times.

passive.name: Guaranteed Victory
passive.text: Increases the wearer's SPD by **18/21/24/27/30%**. The Elation DMG dealt ignores **20/24/28/32/36%** of the target's DEF. When the wearer uses Ultimate on themselves, gains **20/25/30/35/40** point(s) of "Punchline." This effect can be triggered up to 1 time. And resets this trigger count after using Basic ATK **3** time(s).

passive.name: Daydream
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by **60/75/90/105/120%** and Energy Regeneration Rate by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**. When the wearer's Max Energy is greater than **120**, for every 10 points of Max Energy that exceeds this amount, further increases Energy Regeneration Rate by **0.3%**. Up to a maximum of **360** points of excess Max Energy can be taken into account. When the wearer uses Elation Skill, increases the DMG received by all enemies by **15/18.75/22.5/26.25/30%** for **2** turn(s). Effects of the same type cannot stack.

passive.name: Whisper
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Elation by **20/25/30/35/40%**. During the use of Elation Skill by the wearer, ignores **8/10/12/14/16%** of the target's DEF.

passive.name: Decision
passive.text: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When the wearer uses an Elation Skill, increases Elation by **12/14/16/18/20%**, stacking up to **2** times.

passive.name: Rumble
passive.text: Increases the wearer's Elation by **12/14/16/18/20%**. When the wearer uses an Elation Skill, increases Elation DMG taken by all enemies by **6/7/8/9/10%** for **2** turn(s).

passive.text: Increases the wearer's Elation by **20/25/30/35/40%**. During the use of Elation Skill by the wearer, ignores **8/10/12/14/16%** of the target's DEF.

skillPriority: Elation Skill > Talent > Ultimate > Skill > Basic
tracePriority: Revel in Raging Tides (A4) > Party in Perfect Paradise (A2) > Sift Through Gilded Dreams (A6)

entries.name: Dead Center, the Torrent Hits
entries.text: Deals Quantum DMG equal to **100%** of Aventurine • Waveflair's ATK to one designated enemy.

entries.name: Kill Shot, the Sands Boil
entries.text: Deals Quantum DMG equal to **240%** of Aventurine • Waveflair's ATK to all enemies. Gains **4** Punchline and **4** "Fervor."

entries.name: Grand Slam, Crest That High Tide
entries.text: Deals Quantum DMG equal to **400%** of Aventurine • Waveflair's ATK to all enemies. Gains **6** Punchline and **8** "Fervor." Increases this unit's SPD by **30%**, lasting for **4** turn(s).

entries.name: Ante Up, the Abyss Answers
entries.text:
The duration of Aventurine • Waveflair's "Certified Banger" increases by 1 turn. After a teammate uses an attack, Aventurine • Waveflair gains **1** "Fervor" and **1** Punchline. "Fervor" is capped at **30** points.
When "Fervor" reaches **10**, Aventurine • Waveflair uses 1 instance of "Cheers! To Summer's Blaze" that takes into account a fixed amount of **20** Punchline. After this use, the next Elation Skill used by this unit in the Aha Instant gets enhanced into "All In! To Summer's Blaze."
While Aventurine • Waveflair holds "Certified Banger," Skill additionally deals **40%** Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies, and Ultimate additionally deals **72%** Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies.

entries.name: Make Waves in Still Waters
entries.text: Moves forward rapidly for a set distance, attacking all enemies in contact and blocking all incoming attacks. After entering combat via actively attacking enemies, deals Quantum DMG to all enemies equal to **100%** of Aventurine • Waveflair's ATK, and gains **2** "Fervor" and **20** "Certified Banger." Technique Points are not consumed if no enemies are hit.

entries.name: Cheers! To Summer's Blaze
entries.text: Deals **60%** Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies, and additionally deals **10** instance(s) of DMG, with each instance dealing **18%** Quantum Elation DMG to one random enemy.

entries.name: All In! To Summer's Blaze
entries.text: Deals **60%** Quantum Elation DMG to all enemies, and additionally deals **10** instances of DMG, with each instance dealing **18%** Quantum Elation DMG to one random enemy. Consumes all "Fervor" upon use. For every 1 point of "Fervor" consumed, additionally deals 1 instance of **21%** Quantum Elation DMG to one random enemy.

entries.name: Party in Perfect Paradise
entries.text: When SPD is **140** or higher, increases this unit's Elation by **30%**. For every **1** SPD exceeding that threshold, additionally increases this unit's Elation by **1%**. Up to a max of **200** excess SPD can be taken into account for this effect.

entries.name: Revel in Raging Tides
entries.text:
At the start of combat, if the team includes an Elation character besides Aventurine • Waveflair, then while Aventurine • Waveflair is on the field, increases all allies' Elation by **20%** and Aventurine • Waveflair's Elation by an additional **80%**.
At the start of combat, if Aventurine • Waveflair is the only Elation character in the team, then when Aventurine • Waveflair uses Elation Skill to deal DMG, it is considered as having launched Follow-Up ATK. After a teammate uses an attack, Aventurine • Waveflair gains **2** "Certified Banger" and **1** Punchline, and increases Aha's SPD by **25**. The SPD Boost effect lasts until the end of Aha Instant.

entries.name: Sift Through Gilded Dreams
entries.text: Increases CRIT DMG by **48%**. After a teammate uses Basic ATK, Skill, Follow-Up ATK, or Ultimate, all allies' CRIT DMG increases by **48%**, lasting for **3** turn(s), and Aventurine • Waveflair additionally gains **2** "Fervor." This effect can trigger up to **6** time(s), and the trigger count resets when Aventurine • Waveflair uses Skill.

entries.name: A Holiday on the Line
entries.text:
Increases All-Type RES PEN by 24%.
Talent gets enhanced: When "Fervor" reaches 10/20/30 points, immediately uses "Cheers! To Summer's Blaze."

entries.name: Idle as the Turning Tide
entries.text: Increases the upper limit of "Fervor" to 50 points. "Fervor" reaching 40/50 points can also trigger the Talent to use "Cheers! To Summer's Blaze." After using Elation Skill, additionally gains 4 "Fervor."

entries.name: A Rendezvous Served Chilled
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Sunlight Runs No Tab
entries.text: When Aventurine • Waveflair uses Skill, enables the DMG dealt by all allies to ignore 18% of enemy targets' DEF, lasting for 3 turn(s).

entries.name: Into the Eye of the Jackpot
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
Elation Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: The Past in Fast Lane
entries.text: Elation DMG dealt by Aventurine • Waveflair merrymakes by 25%. After Aventurine • Waveflair uses his Elation Skill 2 time(s), all subsequent Elation Skills used become "All In! To Summer's Blaze." And when using the Elation Skill "All In! To Summer's Blaze" to additionally deal DMG outside of Aha Instant, it no longer consumes "Fervor."
